rows.description: A stranger online calls me mature and special and asks me to keep our chats secret. Recognise it: secrecy and flattery are grooming warning signs. Tell a trusted adult; it is not my fault.

rows.description: Someone threatens to share my photos unless I send more. Do not comply or pay; stop replying, save evidence, tell an adult and report to cybercrime helplines. It is a crime, and the shame belongs to them.

rows.description: A message promises a prize, a job or easy money if I pay a small fee or share an OTP. Recognise it: real offers do not ask for money or codes. Do not share OTPs; tell a parent.
